name: Calm Reflection
intro: Welcome to a space of quiet observation.
There's nothing to achieve here. No destination to reach.
Just you, watching the landscape of your inner world.
Let your breathing slow until it barely makes a sound.
Like the surface of still water, let your mind settle.
body: Picture yourself sitting at the edge of a calm lake.
The water is perfectly still. It reflects everything above it without effort.
Your mind can be like this water.
Thoughts will come like ripples. A memory. A worry. A plan.
Watch each one arrive, spread, and dissolve back into stillness.
What is the quality of this moment?
Not good or bad. Just... what is it? What texture does it have?
Is it heavy or light? Warm or cool? Open or tight?
You don't need to change it. Just name it softly to yourself.
Naming something is the first act of understanding.
Let your awareness float backward through today.
Not searching for anything. Just drifting.
What moments stand out? Not the biggest ones. The quiet ones.
A breath you took. A face you saw. A sound that caught your ear.
These small moments are the real fabric of your life.
Now let your awareness rest on nothing at all.
Not your thoughts. Not your body. Not even your breath.
Just the space behind everything. The silence underneath the sound.
This emptiness isn't lonely. It's vast. It's peaceful.
You can always return here. It's never gone.
Before we close, ask yourself one quiet question.
What do I need right now? Not what I should need. What I actually need.
Listen for the answer. It might come as a word. A feeling. An image.
Whatever arrives, accept it without judgment.
You've just listened to the wisest part of yourself.
closing: The stillness you found here doesn't leave when you open your eyes.
It lives underneath everything. Always accessible.
Take one last breath in this quiet place.
And gently, softly, return to the world.
You carry the calm with you now.
